title: Append scale_runs table + v_pareto_frontier view DDL to create_tables.sql
description: Add scale_runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and v_pareto_frontier CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW to etl4/infra/create_tables.sql. scale_runs DDL aligned to the running T-005 schema (source/noise/engine NOT NULL without DEFAULT, column order: scale_run_id, recorded_at, data_volume_rows, source, method, noise, wall_secs, rows_per_sec, peak_rss_mb, shuffle_mb, engine, seed, notes). View follows the task-provided SQL (5 cols: method, noise, accuracy_y, cost_x, efficiency) with filters rmse_m IS NOT NULL AND wall_secs IS NOT NULL.
acceptance_criteria: DDL appends cleanly to create_tables.sql without touching prior statements
docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 < create_tables.sql runs twice with exit 0 and no destructive effects
\d scale_runs shows 13 columns including PK, NOT NULL constraints, and the three indexes (method, volume, recorded_at DESC)
\d v_pareto_frontier shows the view with method, noise, accuracy_y, cost_x, efficiency columns
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_pareto_frontier returns 0 pre-T-003 (expected; rmse_m is NULL in current fact_experiment_result)
contract_deviations: scale_runs: Task-text DDL specified DEFAULT 's3' / 'N0' / 'pandas' on source/noise/engine; running T-005 DDL has NOT NULL with no DEFAULT. Aligned to T-005 (binding running impl) per task instruction. All T-005 inserts pass source/noise/engine explicitly so no behavioural difference.

scale_runs: Task-text column order differs from T-005 (task puts recorded_at last; T-005 puts it second). Aligned to T-005 column order. Postgres treats column order as a presentation detail only; both orders accept the same INSERTs.
scale_runs: Task-text added idx_scale_runs_recorded index not present in T-005. Kept (additive, non-conflicting).

v_pareto_frontier: architecture.md spec includes n_flights and continuity columns and only the rmse_m IS NOT NULL filter. Task-text SQL drops those two columns and adds a wall_secs IS NOT NULL filter. Followed task-text explicitly; architecture deviation flagged. Dashboard T-006 will need the simpler 5-column shape.
